description: Curated offline seed catalog containing verified OWASP Top 10:2025 A05: Injection CVEs for MVP demonstration and offline testing.

advisories.injection_rationale: SQL Injection via QuerySet.annotate(), aggregate(), and extra() with user-controlled column/alias names.
environmental_preconditions: Application must pass untrusted dictionary keys directly into QuerySet.annotate(), aggregate(), or extra().
advisories.summary: Django SQL Injection in QuerySet.annotate(), aggregate(), and extra()

advisories.injection_rationale: SQL Injection in database functions Trunc() and Extract() via untrusted kind or lookup_name arguments.
environmental_preconditions: Application must pass untrusted parameters to Trunc(kind) or Extract(lookup_name).
advisories.summary: Django SQL Injection in Trunc() and Extract() database functions

advisories.injection_rationale: SQL Injection in WP_Query / WP_Tax_Query::clean_query via untrusted taxonomy query parameter.
environmental_preconditions: Site core, theme, or plugin must execute WP_Query with untrusted tax_query array parameters.
advisories.summary: WordPress SQL Injection in WP_Query tax_query

advisories.injection_rationale: CGI Argument Injection on Windows due to Best-Fit character encoding conversion bypassing CVE-2012-1823.
environmental_preconditions: PHP must run on Windows in CGI mode (e.g. Apache with mod_cgi or exposed PHP binary) under Best-Fit code pages (Traditional/Simplified Chinese, Japanese).
advisories.summary: PHP CGI Argument Injection vulnerability leading to Remote Code Execution on Windows

advisories.injection_rationale: Remote Code Execution via Spring MVC Data Binding class.module.classLoader property override on JDK 9+.
environmental_preconditions: Target must run on JDK 9+, use Spring MVC/WebFlux POJO parameter binding, and be packaged as a WAR deployed on Apache Tomcat.
advisories.summary: Spring Framework Remote Code Execution via Data Binding (Spring4Shell)
advisories.advisory_source: VMware Spring Security Advisory CVE-2022-22965 & NVD

advisories.injection_rationale: SpEL Expression / NoSQL Query Injection via untrusted parameters in @Query or @Aggregation MongoDB repository methods.
environmental_preconditions: Application must define MongoDB repository methods with @Query or @Aggregation containing parameter-concatenated SpEL expressions.
advisories.summary: Spring Data MongoDB SpEL Expression Injection vulnerability
advisories.advisory_source: VMware Spring Security Advisory CVE-2022-22980 & NVD

advisories.injection_rationale: Server-Side Template Injection Sandbox Escape via str.format_map in Jinja2 SandboxedEnvironment.
environmental_preconditions: Application must execute untrusted template code within jinja2.sandbox.SandboxedEnvironment where str.format_map is callable.
advisories.summary: Jinja2 Sandbox Escape Server-Side Template Injection via str.format_map
advisories.advisory_source: Pallets Jinja Security Advisory GHSA-462w-v97r-4m45 & NVD
